info.title: Blood Repository Operations API
info.description: Protected connected operations. Detailed access, fields, transitions and recovery limits are in OPERATIONS.md. No MySQL verification or medical interpretation is implied.

200.description: Paginated allowed records and module metadata. Catalogs/assignment detail may omit pagination.

post.summary: Link an unlinked unit to its source
post.description: Requires inventory.write and source-donor assignment. Matching PHT collection date, completed donation and current version. Link is permanent. Unit returns to pending; atomic audit. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.

200.description: Confirmed result

get.description: Inventory/expiry require reports.read; donations require donors.read and active assignment. Filters from/to YYYY-MM-DD, exact location, inventory blood_type and page. Page size 25. No donor/clinical values. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.

200.description: Confirmed result

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start date. Collection date for inventory, expiry date for expiry, donation date for donations. Timestamp boundaries use Asia/Manila.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive end date, on or after from.

parameters.name: blood_type
parameters.description: Exact recorded blood type for inventory/expiry; ignored for donation reports.

post.description: Same scopes/filters as report. Maximum 5000 groups; formula-safe CSV in JSON csv/filename/row_count. Audit required before delivery. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values. Query filters apply to the entire export; page does not limit the export.

200.description: Confirmed result

post.description: Requires availability.publish. Administrator approves public location/component labels and aggregates. Validity is capped by earliest included expiry and invalidated by stock writes. Retry key must retain the same input. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.
Requires availability.publish. Atomic audit; withdrawal never reactivates older publications. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.

200.description: Confirmed result

get.description: System Administrator only. q name/email filter, page >=1; page size 20. Explicit response allowlist. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.

post.description: System Administrator with current-password confirmation. No automatic donor assignment or email. Password 12+ mixed case/number/symbol; duplicate email/key conflict. Audited, hashed credentials. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.

patch.description: System Administrator with current password and version. Email immutable. Cannot change own access or remove last active administrator. Access changes invalidate sessions/reset tokens and revoke assignments/grants. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.

200.description: Confirmed result

get.description: Returns email_recovery_enabled. Off until approved mail is configured; log/array/failover transports cannot be enabled. No authentication required.

post.description: Generic response regardless of account match; only active accounts. Disabled service returns 503. Existing login throttle; broker token throttling. No reset links in logs. Browser writes require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Errors omit secrets and private values.
